senses.gloss:
1. कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making, doing, performing, accom-
plishing, effecting, manufacturing, acting; one who
accomplishes or performs anything, an author; often
occurring at the end of compounds, see सु-कृत्,
कर्म-कृत्, पाप-कृत्, &c.; (त्), m. an affix used
to form nouns from roots; a noun formed with this
affix.
—कृद्-अन्त, अस्, m. a word ending with a
Kṛt affix (such a word would be called by Pāṇini
simply कृत्).
—कृल्-लोप, अस्, m. the rejection of a
Kṛt affix.

कृत् 2. कृत्, (for 1. कृत् see under rt. 1. कृ
at p. 246), cl. 6. P. कृन्तति, चकर्त,
कर्त्स्यति and कर्तिष्यति, अकर्तीत्, कर्तितुम्,
to cut, cut in pieces, cut off, divide; to tear
asunder, destroy: Caus. कर्तयति, to cut, divide,
&c.: Desid. चिकर्तिषति and चिकृत्सति: Intens.
चरीकृत्यते, चरीकर्त्ति; [cf. Lith. kertu, inf. kirsti,
‘to cut;’ Gr. κείρω, κάρσις Slav. korjû, ‘to split;’
Lat. curtus, culter; Hib. ceartaighim, ‘I prune,
trim, cut;’ cuirc, ‘a knife.’]

कृत् 3. कृत्, cl. 7. P. कृणत्ति, चकर्त,
कर्तिष्यति, कर्तितुम्, to twist threads, to
spin; to surround, encompass; attire.

कॄत् कॄत्, cl. 10. P. (sometimes A.) कीर्त-
यति, -ते, -यितुम्, Aor. अचीकृतत् or अचि-
कीर्तत्, to mention, make mention of, tell, name,
call, recite, repeat, relate, declare, communicate, com-
memorate, celebrate, praise, glorify; [cf. Lat. celeber.]

कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done, made, accomplished, per-
formed; prepared, made ready; obtained, gained,
acquired; placed at hand; well done, proper, good.
The preceding senses are mostly found in the Veda;
the numerous other senses found in classical writers
may be inferred from the meanings of the rt. कृ
above. The neuter of कृत is used with सह
or with the inst. alone in the sense of ‘done with,’
‘away with,’ ‘enough of,’ ‘no need of,’ &c. (e. g.
कृतं सन्देहेन, away with doubt; कृतम्
परिहासेन, enough of joking). कृत is often
found at the end of a compound, e. g. पूर्व-कृत,
done formerly; जन्मान्तर-कृत, done in a former
state of existence; (अस्), m., N. of one of the Viśva-
devās; of a son of Vasu-deva; of a son of Sannati
and pupil of Hiraṇya-nābha; of a son of Kṛta-ratha
and father of Vibudha; of a son of Jaya and father
of Haryavana; of a son of Cyavana and father of
Upari-cara; (अम्), n. deed, work, action; service
[]
done, kind action, benefit; consequence, result; aim,
object, design; stake at a game; prize or booty
gained in battle; N. of the die or of the side of a die
marked with four points; (according to some) the
collective name of the four dice in opposition to the
fifth die, called कलि; N. of the first of the four ages
of the world (also called सत्य or ‘the golden age’)
comprehending together with the morning and even-
ing dawn 4,800 years of men, according to the
Mahā-bhārata; but according to the Purāṇas 4,800
years of the gods, or 1,728000 years of men.
—कृत-कपट, अस्, आ, अम्, deceiving, beguiling,
fraudulent.
—कृत-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has performed what was to be done, who has
done his duty; having done or discharged one's
duty.
—कृत-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has done
his work or duty; skilful, clever, able.
—कृत-कल्प,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who knows the customary rites.
—कृत-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desire is
attained or fulfilled.
—कृत-कार्य, अम्, n. an
attained object; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who has done his
work or obtained his object; one who has no need of
another person's aid (with inst.).
—कृत-काल, अस्,
m. appointed time; (अस्, आ, अम्), fixed, settled as to
time; sent, deposited &c. for a certain time; one
who has accomplished a certain time, who has waited
a certain time.
—कृत-कूर्च्छक, अस्, आ, अम्, tied
up as a small bundle or brush.
—कृत-कृत्य, अम्,
n. what has been done and what is to be done; an
attained object; (अस्, आ, अम्), having successfully
accomplished a business; one who has accomplished
or attained any object or purpose; contented, satis-
fied; clever.
—कृतकृत्य-ता, f. or कृतकृत्य-
त्व, अम्, n. the full discharge of any duty or realisa-
tion of any object, accomplishment, attainment,
success.
—कृत-कोटि, इस्, m., N. of a Kāśyapa; an
epithet of Upavarṣa.
—कृत-कोप, अस्, आ, अम्,
angry, indignant.
—कृत-कौतुक, अस्, ई, अम्,
playful.
—कृत-क्रय, अस्, m. a purchaser, a buyer.
—कृत-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has finished or
accomplished any object in which he is engaged;
one who has attained his end or object; one who
has fulfilled his duty or performed a religious cere-
mony.
—कृत-क्रुध, अस्, आ, अम्, angry, resentful.
—कृत-क्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, one who is waiting
for the exact moment, one who waits impatiently for
a person or thing, (with प्रति or with the inf. or
at the end of a comp., e. g. कृत-क्षणाहं ते
गमनम् प्रति, I am waiting impatiently for thy
going; ते भूमिं गन्तुं कृत-क्षनाः, they
are waiting for the time to proceed to the earth);
(अस्), m., N. of a prince.
—कृत-घात-यत्न, अस्,
आ, अम्, making efforts to slay, one who tries to kill.
—कृत-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying past trans-
actions or (benefits) done, unmindful of (services)
rendered, recompensing evil for good, not acknow-
ledging good offices or benefits received, ungrateful;
defeating or rendering vain all previous measures.
—कृतघ्न-ता, f. or कृतघ्न-त्व, अम्, n. in-
gratitude.
—कृत-चूड, अस्, m. a boy on whom the
ceremony of tonsure has been performed.
—कृत-
चेतस्, आस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
—कृत-च्छिद्रा, f.
the plant Luffa Acutangula.
—कृत-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ,
born, produced, generated.
—कृत-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
remembering past transactions, mindful of former aid
or favours, grateful; observing propriety, correct
in conduct; (अस्), m. a dog; an epithet of Śiva.
—कृतज्ञ-ता, f. or कृतज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. gratitude.
—कृतञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of the seventeenth
Vyāsa; also of a prince.
—कृत-तनुत्राण, अस्, आ,
अम्, mailed, having covered one's self with armour.
—कृत-तीर्थ, अस्, m. one who has visited holy
places &c., one who frequents them; a guide; an
adviser, one fertile in expedients.
—कृत-त्रा, f., N.
of a plant, = त्रायमाणा.
—कृत-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of being done or effected.
—कृत-दार, अस्, आ,
अम्, married; [cf. दारक्रिया.]
—कृत-दास, अस्,
m. one who offers himself as a servant for a certain
time, a self-engaged servant, a hired servant.
—कृत-
द्युति, इस्, f., N. of the wife of king Citraketu.
—कृत-द्विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. angry with the
[]
doings of another person.
—कृत-धन्वन्, आ, m.,
N. of a son of Kanaka.
—कृत-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ,
prudent, considerate; learned, educated.
—कृत-
ध्वंस, अस्, आ, अम्, defeated, overpowered; injured,
destroyed; destroying past transactions; [cf. कृत-
घ्न.]
—कृत-ध्वज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. furnished
with banners; (अस्), m., N. of a prince, a son of
Dharma-dhvaja.
—कृत-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, lost
after being once possessed or acquired.
—कृत-
नख, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has cleaned his nails.
—कृत-नाशक, अस्, ई, अम्, ungrateful; [cf. कृत-
घ्न.]
—कृत-नित्यक्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having duly
attended to the daily religious observances.
—कृत-
निर्णेजन, अस्, m. a penitent, one who has per-
formed penance or made expiation.
—कृत-निश्चय,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has made a resolution, resolved,
determined; confident, sure, certain.
—कृत-पर्व,
अम्, n. (?) the golden age of the world.
—कृत-
पश्चात्ताप, अस्, आ, अम्, showing regret or penitence.
—कृत-पुङ्ख, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one who has fixed
the feathers of his arrows,’ skilled in archery.
—कृत-
पुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished in virtuous acts.
—कृत-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, done formerly.
—कृत-
पूर्व-नाशन, अम्, n. forgetting past services, in-
gratitude; [cf. कृत-घ्न.]
—कृत-पूर्विन्, ई,
इणी, इ, one by whom anything was formerly done.
—कृत-पौरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, behaving gallantly.
—कृत-प्रणाम, अस्, आ, अम्, making obeisance,
saluting.
—कृत-प्रतिकृत, अम्, n. assault and
counter-assault; attack and resistance; retaliation
for an assault.
—कृत-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, ful-
filling a promise or agreement.
—कृत-प्रयत्न,
अस्, आ, अम्, making effort, active, industrious, per-
severing.
—कृत-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, successful,
fruitful; (अम्), n. result, consequence of an act; a
poisonous substance; (आ), f., N. of a plant; [cf. कोल-
शिम्बी.]
—कृत-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of a prince.
—कृत-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, laying hands upon, touch-
ing.
—कृत-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has made
a resolution, a man of resolute or firm character;
resolved; informed of one's duty, one who knows
how religious rites ought to be conducted; learned,
wise.
—कृत-ब्रह्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. one who has
performed his devotions; (a deity) towards whom
devotion is made, (a sacrifice) in which prayers are
duly offered.
—कृत-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, alarmed,
apprehensive.
—कृत-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose
mind is directed towards anything, determined, re-
solved.
—कृत-भूत-मैत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, friendly
to all.
—कृत-भोजन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
dined or made a meal.
—कृत-मङ्गल, अस्, आ,
अम्, blessed, consecrated.
—कृत-मति, इस्, इस्, इ,
one who has taken a resolution, one who has resolved
upon anything.
—कृत-मन्दार, अस्, m., N. of a
man.
—कृत-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, angry, offended,
indignant.
—कृत-मार्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having a road
or path made; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—कृत-माल,
अस्, m. a species of animal; the tree Cassia Fistula.
—कृत-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, skilled, clever, conver-
sant.
—कृत-मैत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, friendly.
—कृत-
यजुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, Ved. one who has uttered the
sacrificial formulas.
—कृत-यज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of a
son of Cyavana and father of Uparicara.
—कृत-
यशस्, आस्, m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras.
—कृत-युग, अम्, n. the first of the four ages
of the world; the golden age; see कृत above.
—कृत-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, joining in combat.
—कृत-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a grandson of Maru.
—कृत-रव, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, singing.
—कृत-रुच्, क्, क्, क्, splendid, brilliant.
—कृत-
रुष, अस्, आ, अम्, angry, displeased.
—कृत-
लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, stamped; branded;
noted for good qualities, excellent, amiable, &c.;
defined, discriminated; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
—कृत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, making, having done or
made anything; one who holds the stake at a game.
—कृत-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of several princes,
especially of a son of Hṛdika, also of Kanaka or
Dhanaka; N. of the father of the thirteenth Arhat
of the present Avasarpiṇī.
—कृत-वाप, अस्, m. a
penitent who has shaven his head and chin.
—कृत-
[]
विकार or कृत-विक्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, altered, changed.
—कृत-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, displaying valour,
making vigorous efforts.
—कृत-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who has acquired knowledge, well informed,
scientific, a philosopher.
—कृत-विवाह, अस्, आ, अम्,
married.
—कृत-विस्मय, अस्, आ, अम्, astonished,
astonishing.
—कृत-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being strong
or powerful; (अस्), m., N. of a prince, a son of
Kanaka or Dhanaka and father of Arjuna.
—कृत-
वेग, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—कृत-वेतन, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who receives wages, a hired servant or
labourer.
—कृत-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, grateful, observ-
ant of propriety, knowing what is correct; see कृत-
ज्ञ.
—कृत-वेधक or कृत-वेधन, अस्, m. a
plant, a sort of Ghoṣa with white flowers.
—कृत-
वेपथु, उस्, उस्, उ, trembling.
—कृत-वेश, अस्, आ,
अम्, attired, ornamented, decorated.
—कृत-व्य-
धन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having weapons, armed.
—कृत-व्यलीक, अस्, आ, अम्, annoyed, vexed,
irritated.
—कृत-व्रत, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Loma-harṣaṇa.
—कृत-शक्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, putting
forth one's strength or courage.
—कृत-शस्त्र-
निःश्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, exercised in arms.
—कृत-
शिल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has learned his art or is
skilled in his own trade.
—कृत-शोभ, अस्, आ, अम्,
splendid, brilliant; beautiful, beautified; dexterous,
handy.
—कृत-शौच, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed,
freed from bodily impurities, released from conven-
tional defilement &c.
—कृत-श्रम, अस्, आ, अम्,
one who has made great exertions, painstaking,
laborious; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni.
—कृत-सं-
सर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, brought into contact, united.
—कृत-संस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, initiated, one who has
undergone all the purificatory ceremonies.
—कृत-
सङ्कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has made a resolu-
tion.
—कृत-सङ्केत, अस्, आ, अम्, making an
agreement or appointment.
—कृत-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who never loses his self-consciousness, one
who has presence of mind; aroused; restored to
consciousness or animation; distinguished by appro-
priate marks, devices, &c.
—कृत-सन्नाह, अस्,
आ, अम्, cased in armour.
—कृत-सन्निधान, अस्,
आ, अम्, brought into contact, approximated.
—कृत-
सम्बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, connected, allied.
—कृत-
सापत्निका or कृत-सापत्नी or कृत-सापत्नीका or
कृत-सापत्नका or कृत-सपत्निका, f. a woman
whose husband has taken another wife; a superseded
wife.
—कृत-स्थिति, इस्, इस्, इ, abiding, staying, taking
up an abode.
—कृत-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, showing
affection, affectionate.
—कृत-स्मर, अस्, m., N.
of a mountain.
—कृत-स्वस्त्ययन, अस्, आ, अम्,
blessed, commended to the protection of gods pre-
vious to any journey or undertaking.
—कृत-
स्वेच्छाहार (˚स्व-इच्छा-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding
at pleasure.
—कृत-हस्त or कृत-हस्तक, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has exercised his hands; dexterous;
skilled in archery; clever, skilful, dexterous.
—कृत-
हस्त-ता, f. dexterity; the being skilled in archery.
—कृताकृत (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, done and not
done, done in part but not completed, done and
omitted, prepared and not prepared, manufactured
and not manufactured; (अम्), n. what has been done
and what has not been done.
—कृतागम (˚त-
आग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has made progress,
advanced, proficient.
—कृतागस् (˚त-आग्˚), आस्, आस्,
अस्, one who has committed an offence, offending,
criminal, sinful, in fault.
—कृताग्नि (˚त-अग्˚), इस्,
m., N. of a son of Kanaka or Dhanaka.
—कृताग्नि-
कार्य, अस्, m. a Brāhman who has offered the usual
fire-oblation.
—कृताङ्क (˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
marked, branded; numbered.
—कृताञ्जलि (˚त-अञ्˚),
इस्, इस्, इ, one who joins the hands in reverence or to
solicit a favour (keeping the palms from touching as if
to hold alms or an offering), standing in a reverent or
respectful posture; (इस्), m. a shrub used in medicine,
also in magical potions &c.
—कृताञ्जलिपुट, अस्, आ,
अम्, joining the palms of the hands for obeisance,
also for holding water &c.
—कृतात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚),
आ, आ, अ, one whose spirit is disciplined, subdued,
tranquil; of a self-governed spirit.
—कृतानति (˚त-
आन्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, bending, bowing, paying homage or
[]
respect.
—कृतानुकर (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, imi-
tating what has been done by another, following
another's example, subservient, not independent.
—कृतानुकूल्य (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, compliant,
kind, favouring.
—कृतानुकृत (˚त-अन्˚), अम्, n.
that which is done before and after.
—कृतानुव्या-
ध (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, combined, united.
—कृतानुसार (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, m. established practice,
usage, custom, rate.
—कृतान्त (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, causing an end, bringing to an end, leading to

—कृतान्न (˚त-अन्˚), अम्, n. pre-
pared or cooked food; digested food, excrement; (अस्,
आ, अम्), eating.
—कृतापकार (˚त-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
injured, wronged; discomfited, overpowered; doing
wrong, offending.
—कृतापकृत (˚त-अप्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, done for and against.
—कृतापदान (˚त-अप्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, completing a great or noble work.
—कृतापराध (˚त-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, guilty, cul-
pable, an offender.
—कृताभय (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, saved from fear.
—कृताभरण (˚त-आभ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated.
—कृताभिसरण-
वेश (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, attired in the dress of a
maiden who goes to meet her lover.
—कृताभिषेक
(˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled, inaugurated; (अस्),
m. a prince &c. who has been inaugurated.
—कृता-
भ्यास (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, trained, exercised,
practised.
—कृताय (˚त-अय), अस्, m. the die called
Kṛta.
—कृतायास (˚त-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, labouring,
suffering.
—कृतार्घ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of the
nineteenth Arhat of the past Utsarpiṇī.
—कृतार्-
तनाद (˚त-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, making cries of pain.
—कृतार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
attained an end or object, having accomplished a
purpose or desire, successful; satisfied, contented;
clever; (अस्), m. a various reading for कृतार्घ.
—कृतार्थ-ता, f. or कृतार्थ-त्व, अम्, n. ac-
complishment of an object, success.
—कृतार्थी-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered successful.
—कृतार्थी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become successful.
—कृतालक (˚त-
अल्˚), अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's attendants.
—कृता-
लय (˚त-आल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has taken up
his abode in any place (often compounded with the
name of a place or country, e. g. स्वर्ग-कृतालयः,
an inhabitant of heaven); (अस्), m. a frog.
—कृता-
लोक (˚त-आल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, supplied with light, lighted.
—कृतावधान (˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, careful,
cautious, prudent, attentive.
—कृतावधि (˚त-अव्˚),
इस्, इस्, इ, fixed, appointed, agreed upon; bounded,
limited.
—कृतावमर्ष (˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
effacing from recollection; intolerant.
—कृतावश्-
यक (˚त-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having done all that is
necessary.
—कृतावसक्थिक (˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
seated on the hams with the knees tied together or the
hips and knees surrounded by a cloth.
—कृतावस्थ
(˚त-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, summoned, called; made
present; fixed, settled.
—कृतावास (˚त-आव्˚), अस्,
m. a lodging; (अस्, आ, अम्), lodging.
—कृताशन
(˚त-अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon.
—कृतासन-
परिग्रह (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, seated.
—कृतास्-
कन्दन (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, assailing, attacking;
effacing from recollection.
—कृतास्त्र (˚त-अस्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, one who has exercised himself in throwing
arrows or other weapons, skilled in archery; armed;
(अस्), m., N. of a warrior.
—कृतास्त्र-ता, f. consum-
mate skill or proficiency in the use of arms.
—कृ-
तास्पद (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, governed, ruled; sup-
porting, resting on; residing in or on, taking up one's
abode.
—कृताहक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. कृत + अहन्),
having performed the daily ceremonies or devotions.
—कृताहार or कृताहारक (˚त-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having eaten food, having made a meal.
—कृताह्-
वान (˚त-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, summoned, called, chal-
[]
lenged.
—कृतेर्ष्य (˚त-ईर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, envious,
jealous.
—कृतोच्चैस्^1 (˚त-उच्˚), ind. raised on high.
—कृतोत्साह (˚त-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, making effort,
striving.
—कृतोदक (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has performed his ablutions.
—कृतोद्वाह (˚त-
उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, performing penance by standing
with uplifted hands; married.
—कृतोपकार (˚त-
उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, assisted, befriended; friendly, giving
aid.
—कृतोपचार (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, served,
waited upon.
—कृतोपनायन (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, m. a
student who has been invested with the sacrificial
cord.
—कृतोपभोग (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, used,
enjoyed.
—कृतौजस् (˚त-ओज्˚), आस्, m., N. of a son
of Kanaka or Dhanaka.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk. on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/322, batch 303. note: from uććais.

कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, divided; desired, sought,
wished for.
कृता, f., Ved. an abyss (?).

कृतक, अस्, आ, अम्, artificial, factitious, done arti-
ficially, made, prepared, not produced spontaneously;
not natural, adopted (as a son); assumed, simulated,
false; (अम्), ind. in a simulated manner; (अस्), m.,
N. of a son of Vasu-deva, also of a son of Cyavana.

कृतय, nom. P. कृतयति, -यितुम्, to take the
die called Kṛta.
कृतान्त, कृतार्थ. See under कृत above.
कृतान्त कृतान्त, कृतार्थ. See p. 247.

1. कृति, इस्, f. (for 2. see col. 2), doing, making, per-
forming, manufacturing, composing; action, activity;
creation, work, literary work; magic; enchantment;
an enchantress, a witch; a kind of Anuṣṭubh metre
consisting of two Pādas of twelve syllables each and
a third Pāda of eight syllables; another metre, a
stanza of four lines with twenty syllables in each; a
square number; N. of the wife of Saṃhrāda and
mother of Pañca-jana; (इस्), m., N. of several persons.
—कृति-साध्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being ac-
complished by exertion.

2. कृति, इस्, m. or f. (for 1. see col. 1), Ved. a
kind of weapon, a sort of knife or a dagger; (इस्),
f. hurt, hurting, injuring; waylaying.
—कृति-कर,
अस्, m. epithet of Rāvaṇa.
—कृति-मत्, आन्, m. the
founder of a race, realm, &c.; N. of a son of Yavī-
nara.
—कृति-रात, अस्, m., N. of a prince; [cf. कीर्त्ति-
रात.]
—कृति-रोमन्, आ, m., N. of a son of Kṛtirāta.

कृत्ति, इस्, f. skin, hide; a garment made of skin;
the hide or skin on which the religious student sits,
sleeps, &c., usually the skin of an antelope; the birch
tree; the bark of the birch tree, used for writing
upon, for making hooka pipes, &c.; one of the
lunar mansions, the Pleiads; a house; [cf. Hib.
cart; Lat. cortex.]
—कृत्ति-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a
prince.
—कृत्ति-वास, अस्, m. or कृत्ति-वासस्, आस्,
m. covered with a skin, an epithet of Rudra-Śiva;
(आस्), f. epithet of Durgā.

कृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, expert; clever, skilful, knowing,
wise, learned; good, virtuous; pure, pious; following,
obeying, doing what is enjoined; one who has at-
tained an object or accomplished a purpose, satisfied;
(ई), m., N. of a son of Cyavana and father of Upari-
cara; N. of a son of Sannatimat.

कृते and कृतेन, ind. (originally loc. and inst.
fr. कृत), on account of, for the sake of, for (with
gen. or in comp., e. g. मम कृते or मत्-कृते, on
my account, for me).
कृतेयुक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Raudrāśva.

कृत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, working well, able to work,
powerful; skilful, clever, an artificer or mechanic, an
artist.

कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done or performed;
practicable, feasible; right, proper to be done; one
who may be seduced from allegiance or alliance, one
who may be bribed or hired as an assassin, treacherous;
(अस्), m., scil. प्रत्यय, the class of affixes forming
the fut. pass. part. &c. (as तव्य, अनीय, य, एलिम,
&c.); a kind of evil spirit or ghost, either with or
without the addition of यक्ष, मानुष, असुर,
&c.; (आ), f. action, act, deed; magic; a female deity
to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and
magical purposes; N. of a river; (अम्), n. what
ought to be done; duty, office; purpose, end, object;
what is proper or fit; motive, cause.
—कृत्य-कल्प-
तरु, उस्, m. title of a work on jurisprudence.
—कृत्य-कल्प-लता, f., N. of a work by Vācaspati-
miśra.
—कृत्य-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m. title of a work
by Śivarāma.
—कृत्य-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, who knows
what is to be done, learned, wise.
—कृत्य-तत्त्व,
अम्, n. ‘the true nature of duty or obligation,’ title of
a work.
—कृत्य-ता, f. seduction from allegiance or
alliance.
—कृत्य-रत्नाकर, अस् or अम् (?), m. or
n. (?), title of a work on jurisprudence.
—कृत्य-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having any business or request or object;
busy, active.
—कृत्य-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. the right way,
the manner in which any object is to be effected.
—कृत्य-विद्, त्, त्, त्, one who knows what ought
to be done, knowing duty, learned, wise.
—कृत्य-
विधि, इस्, m. the way to do anything, a rule, a pre-
cept.
—कृत्या-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. practising magic or
sorcery, bewitching.
—कृत्या-दूषण, अस्, ई, अम्,
or कृत्या-दूषि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. counteracting magic,
destroying its effect.
—कृत्या-रावण, अस् or अम् (?),
m. or n. (?), title of a work.

कृत्यक, अस्, m. an injurer?; (आ), f. an enchan-
tress, a witch, a woman who is the fatal cause of injury
or destruction, the fatal destroyer, the bane.

कृत्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, made artificially, factitious,
artificial, the reverse of what is naturally or spon-
taneously produced; falsified, adopted (as a child);
(अस्), m. incense, olibanum; an adopted son; (अम्),
n. a kind of salt, the common Bit Noben, or Bit
Lavan, obtained by cooking; a sort of perfume [cf.
जवादि]; a kind of collyrium [cf. रसाञ्जन].
—कृत्रिम-धूप, अस्, m. incense, olibanum.^1
—कृत्रिम-धूपक, अस्, m. compound perfume,
containing ten or eighteen ingredients.
—कृत्रिम-
पुत्र, अस्, m. an adopted son; one of the twelve
kinds recognised in law, the son made.
—कृत्रिम-
पुत्रक, अस्, m. a doll.
—कृत्रिम-भूमि, इस्, f. a
made floor.
—कृत्रिम-मित्र, अस्, m. an acquired
friend, one on whom benefits have been conferred,
or from whom they have been received.
—कृत्रिम-
वन, अम्, n. a plantation, a park.
—कृत्रिम-
शत्रु, उस्, m. an acquired enemy.
—कृत्रिमो-
दासीन (˚म-उद्˚), अस्, m. an acquired neutral.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

कृत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. causing, effecting; active,
busy; practising magic or sorcery in order to bewitch.

कृत्वस्, ind. at the end of a numeral or numeral
adjective, = fold, times (e. g. दश-कृत्वस्, ten times;
बहु-कृत्वस्, many times; पञ्च-कृत्वस्, five-fold).
In the earlier language कृत्वस् is used as a separate
word, but native grammarians regard it only as an
affix, and it is so used in classical Sanskrit; it was
perhaps originally an acc. plur. fr. a noun कृतु,
formed by the affix तु fr. the root 1. कृ; [cf. also
कृत् in सकृत्.]
कृत्वा, ind. having made or done.

कृत्वी, f., N. of a daughter of Śuka, wife of
Aṇuha (Nīpa) and mother of Brahma-datta.

कृत्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who is able to
perform anything, strong, efficacious; having accom-
plished many deeds, exerting one's power.

कृत्तिका, आस्, f. pl., N. of a constellation, = the
Pleiades, (originally the first, but in later times the
third lunar mansion, having Agni as its regent; this
constellation, containing six stars, is sometimes re-
presented as a flame or as a kind of razor or knife;
in mythology the six Kṛttikās are nymphs who
became the nurses of the god of war, Kārttikeya);
a vehicle, carriage, cart.
—कृत्तिकाञ्जि (˚का-अञ्˚), इस्,
इस्, इ, having a carriage as an emblem or sign.
—कृत्तिका-भव, अस्, m. ‘being in the lunar
mansion Kṛttikā,’ an epithet of Candra, the moon.
—कृत्तिका-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of the Kṛttikās,’ an
epithet of Skanda or Kārttikeya; (the nymphs called
Kṛttikās being his foster-mothers.)
कृतद्-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. distributing goods (?).

कृत्स, अम्, n. water; entire, whole; [cf. the
next.]

कृत्स्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rarely used in pl.), all, whole,
entire; (अम्), n. water; the flank or hip; the belly.
—कृत्स्न-ता, f. totality, completeness.
—कृत्स्न-
विद्, त्, त्, त्, omniscient, knowing all things.
—कृत्स्न-
शस्, ind. wholly, entirely, altogether.
—कृत्स्न-
हृदय, अम्, n. the whole heart.
—कृत्स्नायत
(˚न-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. stretched out to its full
length.
कृत्स्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, all, every.
कृतार्थयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making successful.
